Both of these factors are known to interact with Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase, indicating a possible pathway where the compound may modulate the activity of these transcription factors, which in turn influence the enzyme's function. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible mechanism where the compound could act as a regulatory agent, influencing the expression or activity of Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase through its interaction with these transcription factors.
